Scope.description: Visibility of KV entries and events. `public` is served over the HTTP API (the browser / rendered surface can read it); `private` is for the producing agent only and is never served on the public endpoints.

description: A backflow/emitted event, written into `{surface}/events/{unix-ms}-{action}.json`. Created by a direct UI submission (backflow) or by a handler via `host.emit`. The agent reads them; `public` events are also served over the events API.

scope.description: Visibility — `public` events are served on the events API; `private` are agent-only.

source.description: `ui` for a direct submission, `handler` for a `host.emit` from a handler.
